name: v2_channel_loglaw
_doc: M3 gate V2 — flat-bed periodic channel log-law (bed-shear wall function) + Jarrin SEM inlet. RESEARCH §4 anchor / §8, research/04/14. Periodic channel is x/y-homogeneous ⇒ 1-D; the mixing-length closure l=κz√(1−z/Lz) yields the analytic log law and the body-force+PI driver locks U_bulk=U_d. u* targets: 0.0345 m/s @ d50=0.2 mm (transitional, ks+≈13), 0.040 m/s @ 1.0 mm (rough). SEM holds ~7% ambient TI (Nezu 7.2% at z=0.5 m) with the projection bounding divergence.
